validations_executed.category: Live Full-Cycle Proof (new site through the UI)
validations_executed.evidence: pinklily.com was added through the dashboard's new Add Site control, which generated its target manifest, starter query pack, and GEN-014 evaluation manifest and started the inspection. Run GEN-014-20260714T193151Z completed in 37 seconds: partial status, Medium confidence, 89% component coverage, Shopify detected at High confidence, all five plugins pass, zero infrastructure limitations, P008 the only capability gap. The Generate Executive Report button then produced executive-report.md/json from the run's retained evidence, and the detail view surfaces the report links.

The onboarded site's run validates end to end. Run validation was corrected during this slice to require dataset files only for datasets reported as generated (DS3 is legitimately empty for starter packs) and to accept any GEN-prefixed inspection ID.

All prior dashboard and dataset viewer assertions pass, plus new coverage: onboarding in an isolated temp root (manifest creation, target id derivation, decision-3A maturity level 2 requirement, five-query starter pack completeness, idempotent re-onboarding, invalid URL rejection) and executive report generation (markdown and JSON artifacts, inspection provenance, explainable per-surface scores with formulas, limitations section, no-re-inspection statement, detail-view linkage).
Contracts, manifests (now accepting GEN-013 and GEN-014 generations, including the onboarded Pink Lily manifests), platform, and inspection validation pass.
Framework validator passes; BDD-012 calibration remains the known deferred warning.
